snippet.title: INTERLOCKED: PUZZLE ISLANDS - GAME UPDATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.
